content.query:
SELECT
    *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'calendar.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        FIRSTROW = 2,
        FIELDTERMINATOR = ',',
        ROWTERMINATOR = '\n'
    )
    WITH (
        date_key       VARCHAR(8) 1,
        [date]         DATE 2,
        [year]         INT 3,
        [month]        TINYINT 4,
        [day]          TINYINT 5,
        day_name       VARCHAR(20) 6,
        day_of_year    SMALLINT 7,
        week_of_month  TINYINT 8,
        week_of_year   TINYINT 9,
        month_name     VARCHAR(20) 10,
        year_month     VARCHAR(6) 11,
        year_week      VARCHAR(6) 12
    ) AS result;
